prayer: PRAYER: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to issue a writ of Mandamus forbearing the respondents from removing the load speaker in St. Xavier Church, T. Saveriyarpuram, Thoothukudi District.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

G.R. Swaminathan, J.:— The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks leave to withdraw this petition and he has also made an endorsement to that effect. Permission is granted.

2. In view of the above, this Writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
